description: This file defines and exports multiple asynchronous functions for interacting with an API related to insurance claims. It contains functions for uploading claim CSV files, listing claims with filtering options, retrieving individual claim details, submitting claim outcomes, and fetching queue and report summaries.

methods.name: uploadClaimsCsv(file)
methods.description: Uploads a CSV file containing claims to the backend for parsing and scoring.

methods.name: listClaims({ q, riskBand, sortBy, sortDir } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claims with optional filtering and sorting parameters.

methods.name: getClaimById(id)
methods.description: Fetches details of a single claim identified by its ID.

methods.name: submitClaimOutcome(id, { outcome, notes } = {})
methods.description: Submits an investigation outcome for a specific claim, including outcome and notes.

methods.name: getQueue()
methods.description: Fetches the list of claims in the investigator's queue.

methods.name: getReportsSummary()
methods.description: Fetches summary metrics used for reports and UI display.

ctags.name: listClaims
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listClaims({ q, riskBand, sortBy, sortDir } = {}) {$/
